flows.narrative: The week ended 9 Sep 2026 showed US equity fund outflows narrowing to -$4.48bn (from -$7.84bn the prior week) -- still net selling, but decelerating -- while money-market funds flipped to a -$5.97bn outflow, a reversal from the prior week's +$22.89bn inflow, and US high-grade bond funds kept taking in money (+$4.74bn, though decelerating from +$7.76bn). This is the first weekly print to partially reflect the run-up into Friday's CPI print; the pattern (equity outflows moderating, cash flows reversing) is consistent with de-risking easing slightly ahead of the FOMC rather than a resumption of risk-taking.
